Metadata.title: {orgName} | Support Air Force veterans
Metadata.description: Give once or monthly to support Air Force veterans and their families.

Pages.placeholder: We're still writing this page. In the meantime, you can make a gift or get in touch.

Home.heroTitle: Every airman needs a wingman. Be one.
Home.heroLead: We're an independent, volunteer-run group raising money for Air Force veterans and their families.

Footer.disclaimer: {orgName} is an independent volunteer organisation and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the U.S. Air Force, the U.S. Space Force, or the Department of Defense.

NotFound.title: We couldn't find that page
NotFound.description: The link may be out of date or the page may have moved.

QuickGive.heading: Make a gift
QuickGive.errorInvalid: Enter an amount in dollars, like 40.
QuickGive.errorMin: The smallest gift we can take online is {min}.
QuickGive.errorMax: For gifts over {max}, please contact us and we'll help you give.
QuickGive.taxDeductible: Tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law

Funds.heading: Where your gift goes
Funds.lead: Choose a fund when you give, or let us put your gift where it's needed most.

general.name: Where it's needed most
general.description: Lets us put your gift to work wherever the need is greatest right now.

emergency.name: Emergency assistance
emergency.description: Helps veterans and their families cover urgent costs like rent, utilities and car repairs.

families.name: Family support
families.description: Supports spouses and children through deployments, illness and loss.

transition.name: Education and transition
transition.description: Helps veterans train for and settle into life after service.

WaysIn.heading: Find your way in

donors.title: Give once or every month
donors.body: Monthly gifts give us steady support we can plan around. One-time gifts go to work right away.
donors.item1: Pick an amount and how often you'd like to give.
donors.item2: Pay by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay.

veterans.title: Find support
veterans.body: If you or your family need help, tell us what's going on and we'll point you to the right support.
veterans.item1: Tell us a little about what's going on.
veterans.item3: We reply by email with next steps, or the right organisation to contact.

companies.title: Partner with us
companies.body: Sponsor a program, match your employees' gifts, or get your team involved.
companies.item1: Sponsor a fund or an event.

volunteers.title: Give your time
volunteers.body: From events to mentoring, there's a way to help that fits your schedule.
volunteers.item2: Lend a professional skill, like design, writing or finance.
volunteers.item3: Spread the word in your unit or community.

WaysIn.lead: Whether you want to give, need support or want to help, start here.

VolunteerBand.title: Can't give right now? Give your time.
VolunteerBand.body: Volunteers run everything we do. Tell us what you're good at and we'll find a fit.
